The research will examine the role of the Do No Significant Harm (DNSH) principle in the evolution of EU environmental law and sustainable public procurement. Field: Law / 12/GIUR-05 Diritto costituzionale e pubblico

The project aims to analyse new environmental and health emergencies arising from the interaction between climate change, ecosystem alteration, and the spread of emerging pathogens, with particular attention to the One Health paradigm. The research will examine crisis management within the Italian legal system, as well as European and international strategies concerning sustainability and health security, together with the impact of new technologies. Particular attention will be devoted to the role of artificial intelligence in prevention, monitoring, and public decision-making processes. The results of the research will be disseminated through scientific publications.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Commercial Law in the Papal States of the Restoration: The Provisional Regulation of 1821 Between the Napoleonic Legacy and the ius commune (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-02 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-16 Storia del diritto medievale e moderno

This research will analyze papal commercial law during the Restoration era, examining the impact of Napoleonic legislation on common law beginning with the 1821 Regulation. The study will examine the debate on commercial jurisdiction, codification projects, and university teaching in Rome. Based on archival sources and contemporary legal scholarship, the study aims to chart the comparison between the “mos italicus” and the French school. The ultimate goal is a comprehensive reconstruction of the system, complete with a bibliography of sources and scholarly publications
